The '''V-19 Torrent starfighter''' was an assault [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] with exceptional speed and maneuverability used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

It was a predecessor of the [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]], in terms of purpose and usage.

==Characteristics==
[[File:V19TorrentDisplay-CotF.png|thumb|left|180px|V-19 console display]]
The V-19 was unique in that it had two pairs of folding airfoils ([[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]]) that gave the ship added maneuverability and provided pilots with easy access to the cockpit's sliding canopy. The lower, hinged S-foils coupled with enhanced [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines made the V-19 an exceptional vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) fighter.

===Armament===
Its armament consisted of two [[laser cannon]]s (one on each wingtip) and two [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers. The number of concussion missiles carried by the V-19 was at least six. At [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], it was shown that these missiles were capable of independently acquiring and tracking their own targets. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] took advantage of this feature to destroy a swarm of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class starfighters]] and a [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|gun platform]].

==History==
===Production rush===
After the prototypes proved successful during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the Republic quickly began full scale production of V-19s to add to the arsenal of the growing [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] to compensate for the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]' ineffectiveness against enemy starfighters. However, due to the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of training it took for the Republic's [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] to become proficient with the vessel, the fighter was not available in large numbers for many of the early engagements of the war. They did not make a prominent showing until the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], where 156 V-19s were carried into action by the ''[[Nevoota Bee/Legends|Nevoota Bee]]'', an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] modified as a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===In Combat===
V-19 fighters were present during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], when Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived with reinforcements to assist General Skywalker. General Kenobi, with aid of [[Davijaan/Legends|Odd Ball]], led the squadron against Separatist Vulture droids. When Skywalker tried to land in the hangar, the vulture droids overtook them on a suicide run, crashing into the hanger and destroying all the V-19s in there, making it impossible for the general to land.<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

[[File:V-19s-Hangar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|V-19s in the hangar]]
They also comprised a significant portion of Skywalker's fighter forces aboard his flagship, the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], especially during the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] crisis.<ref name="RM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

The fighter also saw action during the [[Battle of Kiros]], where Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] freed the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colony world from Separatist forces.<ref name="The Mystery of Kiros">[[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]</ref>

When the peaceful world of Nexus Ortai was brought into the war, the V-19 served as the principal defense fighter against the Separatists in the space portion of the ensuing [[Battle of Nexus Ortai|battle]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref>

[[File:Blue_Squadron_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|250px|Blue Squadron at the Battle of Ryloth]]
Not long after that, V-19 fighters saw action during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] led a squadron against the Separatist blockade, they were caught in a trap and over whelmed, after [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]], Tano's second-in-command was lost, The squadron was ordered to retreat, with only 2 fighters left out of the 15 that took part in the engagement.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

Later, fighters of this class were present during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]], where they defended the flagship of Jedi [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], while she was waiting for reinforcements from Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>

V-19s later served during the [[Battle of Rendili]] under the command of generals [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].<ref name="Battle of Rendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref> They were also deployed during the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

===Design upgrades===
[[File:V-19_Torrent_Starfighter_SotG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]
Initially designed as a short-range fighter, Republic technicians later added a Class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to equip the vessel for escort missions. Some were also modified to use [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|Syluire-31 hyperspace docking rings]].<ref name="Republic 61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref> However, many of the hyperdrive-less fighters remained in service. [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] were sometimes equipped with V-19s instead of V-wings, with a complement of 192. When a Venator opened its dorsal hangar V-19s would often be scrambled as a picket to screen the vulnerable, exposed hangar. The [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] also fielded V-19s. Although the number of fighters these ships could carry is unknown, the ''Acclamator''s that took the strike force to Muunilinst held at least 156 V-19s each.

Torrent starfighters were joined, and nominally replaced, by [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] and V-wings as the main fighters in the Republic's fleet towards the end of the Clone Wars. However, V-19s were still in use by the Republic near the end of the Clone Wars, serving as part of the task force sent to [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|defend]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] shortly before the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

After the execution of the Order 66, the unconscious clone trooper [[HOB-147]] of the [[Light Brigade Division]] was rescued by a man named [[Hurd Coyle]], from the remains of his V-19 Torrent starfighter, where he was lost in space. This clone trooper would befriend young Padawans transported in Coyle's [[Hurd Coyle's ship|salvage ship]], and would not turn them over to Imperial troopers.<ref name="Salvaged">{{CWACite|9|Salvaged}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] continued to utilize Torrents after the end of the Clone Wars, often reassigning these fighters to older carrier vessels and installations in the Outer Rim.<ref name="TFTS" />

A few months after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], followers of the rogue clone trooper [[Kaddak (clone trooper)|Kaddak]] flew them during the [[Shrouded Offensive]]. The [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|separatists]] ambushed [[Green Squadron (Galactic Empire)|Green Squadron]] before disappearing.<ref name="Cry" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tor.jpg|thumb|left|180px|V-19 in different angles]]
[[LucasArts]]' Art Director [[Chris Williams]] and Concept Artist [[Greg Knight]] developed the design of the V-19 Torrent for the 2-D ''Clone Wars'' micro-series. They drew inspiration for the fighter's folding wings from the real-world [[Wikipedia:F4U Corsair|F4U Corsair]].<ref name="db" /> Concept art of the Torrent for the 3-D [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] was drawn up by [[Thang Le]]. The novel ''[[Jedi Trial]]'' misspelled the class as '''T-19''' manufactured by "Torpil".

A LEGO version of the fighter (LEGO STAR WARS - 7674 V-19 Torrent) was released in 2008, and is also a playable vehicle in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''.
